pages.title: Clay Needs Care
pages.text: Transform a Clay Golem Statue into Terracotta Golem and apply a cactus or dead-bush upgrade.

pages.title: Clay Needs Care
pages.text: Two statues supply further transformations and a Candle Golem opens the neighboring construct variant.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The statue transforms through native heat behavior. Cactus and Dead Bush offer different attack roles. Candle Golem uses a separate item transformation; any statue is not automatically a fighter.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place a statue near heat, then use cactus or a dead bush on the golem. The construct can gain an improved melee or ranged attack.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click the Candle Golem item or melt a Clay Golem Statue like ice. The native tooltips specify transformation into Candle Golem or Terracotta Golem.
